name: The Outlets at Orange
description: The Outlets at Orange is a premier outdoor outlet shopping destination in Orange County, California, featuring a diverse collection of brand-name outlet stores offering designer and brand merchandise at discounted prices. Located at the intersection of the I-5 and CA-22 freeways, this open-air outlet center provides easy access for shoppers throughout Southern California. With its convenient location and attractive outdoor setting, The Outlets at Orange combines value shopping with an enjoyable retail experience.
summary: The Outlets at Orange is a popular open-air outlet shopping center in Orange County featuring brand-name stores at discounted prices with convenient freeway access.
